content.title: How to watch Duke vs. LSU women’s basketball: Sweet 16 TV channel and streaming options for March 27
content.text: A Sweet 16 battle will feature the No. 2 seed LSU Tigers (29-5) and the No. 3 seed Duke Blue Devils (26-8) playing on Friday at Golden 1 Center. The NCAA Tournament matchup tips off at 10 p.m. ET.How to watch Duke Blue Devils vs. LSU Tigers Venue: Golden 1 Center Time: 10 p.m. ET Streaming: Fubo (Stream now) TV: ESPN Watching in person? Get tickets on StubHub. Duke vs. LSU odds Spread: LSU -9.5 (-112), Duke +9.5 (-108) Favorite Moneyline: LSU -510 Underdog Moneyline: Duke +378 Total: 145.5 Total Over Odds: -105 Total Under Odds: -115 Odds provided by BetMGM.Stats to know LSU averages 95.3 points per game (first in college basketball) while allowing 60.4 per contest (74th in college basketball). It has a +1188 scoring differential overall and outscores opponents by 34.9 points per game. LSU connects on 5.8 three-pointers per game (202nd in college basketball) at a 37.8% rate (third-best in college basketball), compared to the 7.1 per outing its opponents make while shooting 28.6% from deep. Duke is outscoring opponents by 15.5 points per game, with a +527 scoring differential overall. It puts up 74.2 points per game (43rd in college basketball) and allows 58.7 per contest (38th in college basketball). Duke knocks down 6.4 three-pointers per game (156th in college basketball) at a 33.4% rate (70th in college basketball), compared to the 4.2 per game its opponents make, at a 26.7% rate.
